records.title: I Will Wait Near the Rattlesnakes

Description:
Legend had it that centuries ago, Isabella had made a pact with a powerful sorcerer. In exchange for a wish, she had agreed to guard a sacred treasure hidden deep within the rattlesnake-infested caverns nearby. The sorcerer had warned her that once she accepted this duty, she would be bound to it forever. 

As the years turned into centuries, Isabella's appearance remained unchanged, frozen in time. She watched as civilizations rose and fell, as the desert sands shifted and reshaped the land. She saw countless adventurers come and go, all seeking the fabled treasure that lay hidden within the rattlesnake's lair. But Isabella's duty bound her to protect the secret, and she remained steadfast in her resolve. Despite her immortality, Isabella yearned for freedom. She longed to feel the warmth of the sun on her skin without the haunting presence of the rattlesnakes. She dreamed of exploring the world beyond the desert, of experiencing the joys and sorrows of a life unconstrained.

But as the endless days stretched on, Isabella began to find solace in her role as guardian. She learned to appreciate the serenity of the desert, the silent conversations she had with the rattlesnakes, and the delicate balance of nature that surrounded her. She found strength in her unwavering commitment and discovered a sense of purpose in her eternal wait.

And so, Isabella continues to stand near the rattlesnakes, her story intertwined with theirs. She has become a symbol of resilience and dedication, a testament to the power of duty and the endurance of the human spirit. And as the desert winds whisper her name, Isabella remains, forever waiting, forever guarding, and forever bound to the rattlesnakes.

Velvet Meadow is a psychedelic pop/rock project based in Jacksonville/St Augustine Fl. Founded by psych-head Kris Heironimus, Heironimus strives to create a palette of creative weird sound scapes interwoven within pop melodies. With huge inspiration from many classic psychedelia artists, Mr. Velvet captures a modern, and authentic take on progressive rock with his psych anthem "I See Blue". 

After "I See Blue" garnered more than 400K views on Youtube in the span of 2 months, and still trending upwards within the algorithm. It has solidified his presence within the psych rock community, and brought him a deal with independent record label"SIC RECORDS".  

About the track from Heironimus. 

"I See Blue was a huge leap for me. I was always obsessed with writing and producing at a very young age. At the time, I was in my old band Luna Cruise, and I was super insecure about my music. I wrote this track on a summer Sunday morning at my gfs parents house. I didn't even have studio monitors. I bummed her folks old 1970s technic speakers and receiver. Plugged it into my crappy laptop with Garageband loaded up with my Stratocaster handy. I remember wanting to challenge myself. I wanted to find a crazy guitar tone to use. I spent about 2 hours just playing with various effects until I came across a nasty drive plugin, and a filter. Once I hit that first power chord I already had the song planned out internally. I was beyond excited for this track. It really was the first song Ive written where I wasn't cringing at myself. This track really was the reason I started the Velvet Meadow project. The production and mixing was all done by myself, because I believe half of a songs sound and feel is within the producing. After releasing it with a music video on Youtube, it sat at around 500 views for three years. Then sometime in October of 2023 it blew up and went viral in the span of 2/3 months. I still cant believe it has over 400k views. I am very fortunate to have the fans and the community built around Velvet Meadow. I want to somehow give back within the NFT world. You can acquire this collectible and invest into the project. Everything is only going to go up from here my friends. Thank you <3."

It could be argued that a magical idea referred to as “manifestation” only exists in the perception of an observer. You may be wondering what the author precisely means by “perception of the observer”. That is, the quantum neurological and biochemical phenomenon where there’s a place in your mind that believes dreams can come true. In other words, your imagination. 

However, no one else besides the observer is aware of a particular activation of a single desire. Thoughts become things, don’t they? Therefore, each thought has potential to become a material object, right? 

This song, Anything You Desire (Prosperity Mix) by Sean Allen Fenn, contains a practical message. If you choose to listen to it, it would be helpful to have a very clear picture of what you desire. Before you recognize the lyric, “I am the vine, you are the branches”, keep in mind that this is a metaphor.

“I Am” refers to the name of God. In the Torah, according to the book of Exodus, Elohim (God) first revealed the name “I Am” to Moses at the burning bush when commissioning him to free the Israelites from Egypt. What then, or whom specifically is “Elohim”? This is a plural word. You imagine or perceive the observer to be separate from you; for your desire to manifest from outside of yourself.

In this metaphor, “the vine” is a feeling of your wish fulfilled, which makes “the branches” the manifestation of your wish fulfilled by your own thought, action, and faith. Under the condition that you ask in the name of “I Am”, personified by the one in whom you must believe, ask anything you desire and you will have it.

Originally released on Sean Allen Fenn’s most recent album, Surplus (2022), Anything You Desire (Prosperity Mix) is an alternate mix. Sean Allen Fenn is an American electronic musician who plays guitar and sings without Auto-Tune, which is rare in these trying times.

His first record, The Gutters of Heaven (2004) under the moniker & the Maids of Dishonor was associated with the 00’s indie scene in San Francisco. His follow-up record, No One Ever Sticks Around That Long (2008) was written with microtonal saxophone player Subhraag Singh as a band called The Eidolons in New York City. After a decade hiatus, the music came back from the dead. 

Music software can easily employ AI to assist composers. Since the late 1990’s Sean Allen Fenn had been creating electronic music in the Goth/Industrial scene. Here was a way to outsource the new songs while iterating on the sound of the electronic music he was making even before The Gutters of Heaven record.  

By mid-August 2020, over 100 songs had been written (including 2 at the end of 2019). Half of them were generative electronic songs, 10 of which appear on the first of two new records by Sean Allen Fenn since hiatus: Freedom Gained Precision Lost (Sept 4 2020). The second release, which consists of 11 lyrical songs is titled, Surplus.

Sean is writing the next record at his home studio in San Martin, CA.

Eating disorders are serious mental illnesses that involve abnormal eating habits that negatively impact a person's physical and emotional health. People with eating disorders develop unhealthy obsessions with food, weight, or body image, and they may resort to extreme measures to control them.

There are several different types of eating disorders, each with its own characteristic symptoms. The most common types include:

Anorexia nervosa: People with anorexia nervosa have an intense fear of gaining weight, even when they are underweight. They severely restrict their food intake and may engage in purging behaviors such as vomiting or laxative abuse.

Bulimia nervosa: People with bulimia nervosa experience episodes of uncontrollable eating, called binge eating, followed by purging behaviors to compensate for the calories consumed.

Binge-eating disorder: People with binge-eating disorder also experience episodes of binge eating, but they do not purge afterward. They may feel shame or guilt after a binge, but they are unable to control their eating behavior.

Eating disorders can have serious consequences for a person's physical and mental health. They can lead to malnutrition, dehydration, electrolyte imbalance, heart problems, digestive problems, and even death. Eating disorders can also cause anxiety, depression, social isolation, and suicidal thoughts.

If you or someone you know is struggling with an eating disorder, it is important to seek professional help. With treatment, people with eating disorders can recover and live healthy, fulfilling lives.

There are several resources available to help someone with an eating disorder:

National Eating Disorders Association (NEDA): They provide a helpline, screening tools, and a search function to find treatment providers in your area https://www.nationaleatingdisorders.org/.

Doctor or Therapist: A doctor can perform a physical examination and recommend treatment options. Therapists can provide psychological therapy to address the underlying causes of the eating disorder.

Registered Dietitian: A dietitian can help develop a healthy meal plan and provide education on nutrition.

Here are some additional resources:

International Association of Eating Disorder Professionals (iaedp): 
This organization offers a directory of certified eating disorder specialists 
[eating disorder specialists directory].

Eating Disorder Hope: This website provides information and support for people with eating disorders and their loved ones [eating disorder hope ON Eating Disorder Hope eatingdisorderhope.com].

Remember, you are not alone.  Help is available and recovery is possible.

records.title: Good Bye Lover, Good Bye Friend

Description:
Drawing from themes of death, the present, satire, and spirituality, "Good Bye Lover, Good Bye Friend" marks the first single from Tropical Man Go, the latest project by Latin Grammy winner, VINILOVERSUS drummer, and visual artist Orlando “Mangan” Martínez. This debut single, released on all streaming platforms on April 3, 2020, is now being introduced as a digital asset on sound.xyz, inviting listeners to own a piece of this pivotal moment in Mangan's musical journey.

Recorded in Los Angeles during the summer of 2019, "Good Bye Lover, Good Bye Friend" is a testament to Mangan's multifaceted artistry. The track delves into the inevitability of death and the universal experience of farewells, inspired by the passing of David Bowie. It skillfully blends visceral harmonies and percussive elements, showcasing Mangan's ability to channel inner turmoil into a serene soundscape. The song speaks to the departure from the physical plane, exploring themes of love, friendship, and the ultimate goodbye.

The creation of this track was a collaborative effort, featuring contributions from Henry D’Arthenay of La Vida Boheme, adding his magical touch, Samantha Dagnino in backing vocals, and El Negro Álvarez on percussion. Produced by Rudy Pagliuca, mixed by Carlos Imperatori, and mastered by Marcel Fernández—all Latin Grammy winners—the song is a showcase of exceptional talent and shared artistic vision. "Good Bye Lover, Good Bye Friend" serves as the lead single from what will be the artist's first EP, 001.

Tropical Man Go is described by Mangan as a low-tempo, acoustic project that blends English and Spanish in a style he dubs "Indie Coffee." This project merges the two worlds of his artistic upbringing, reflecting over a decade of Mangan's work in music, visual arts, and multimedia. It represents his artistic thesis, embodying the notion that art lacks substance without a guiding concept.

As "Good Bye Lover, Good Bye Friend" transitions to a digital asset on sound.xyz, it not only offers a new way for fans to engage with and invest in Mangan's work but also sets a precedent for how artists can share their creations in the digital age. This release is more than just a song; it's an invitation to experience the depth of Mangan's artistic expression and a call to reflect on the profound themes that inspire it. Join Tropical Man Go on this journey and become part of the story that "Good Bye Lover, Good Bye Friend" tells—a narrative of endings that lead to new beginnings, encapsulated in a digital format that bridges the gap between music and artistry in the modern era.

"Mage" is the third single from the debut Supersigil album Spectres, mastered by Rafael Anton Irisarri at Black Knoll Studio (NY).

Spectres comprises 13 experimental tracks produced over the last seven years—the 28th release in my discography but my first ever completely solo full-length album. While working on this record, I delved deep into Jungian psychology, concepts from which became central to the project. All 13 tracks are named after archetypes—innate, universal forces that shape our experience of the world.

Spectres is also a visual art project. For each of the 13 tracks, I trained a bespoke AI GAN on consensually crowd-sourced images submitted in response to the corresponding archetype. By limiting the training time of these custom image-to-image models, I found I could achieve results that mirrored the formation of archetypal symbols as I imagine them deep in our collective unconscious: elusive yet powerful forms emerging from abstract swirls of colour. I think of this process as filtering the archetypal forces through contributors' personal psyches before channelling them back into the realm of the universal. For the album cover I trained another GAN on outputs from all the previous GANs combined, resynthesising the individual archetypal energies to forge an integrated whole.

Spectres is more than a collection of WAVs and JPGs; it is a dialogue between the personal and the universal, a multidisciplinary exploration of the forces that connect us all. The album has taken me on a transformative seven-year journey through sound, imagery and psyche. In the resulting work, individual and collective experience harmonise, revealing the profound depths of human interconnectedness.

Before its official release on 11/23, I'm rolling Spectres out across the web3 ecosystem, dropping tracks on Sound, Zora, Lens and other emerging platforms. In a novel release structure, collectors of individual tracks gain instant access to stream the full album months before its official release. The goal is to push the limits of onchain interoperability to explore what a web3-native album release can look like in 2024.

this came from an experiment with my modular synthesizers, where i created a really interesting sequence using the moog subharmonicon. the pattern is set to stochastically, or randomly, change, but all evened out to really lovely intervals and tones. the uniqueness of this piece is what happened after -- it was recorded directly to 1/4' reel to reel revox b77 tape machine. from there, i resampled it between a tascam 424 mk i and a tascam 844 over 10 times. through the process of rerecording the sequence between tapes creates beautiful degradation as the magnetic tape wears and alters.

Loneliness is indeed a significant and growing concern, reaching epidemic levels in recent years. Here's a breakdown of the situation:

Prevalence:

Half of U.S. adults report experiencing loneliness. This translates to a staggering number of people feeling a disconnect from meaningful social connections.

Young adults are disproportionately affected. Research suggests they experience loneliness at twice the rate of older adults.
Social isolation exacerbates the issue. Factors like poverty, lack of access to transportation, and limited social networks contribute to loneliness.
Impact:

Loneliness is a public health crisis. It has severe consequences for both physical and mental health.
Increased risk of health problems: Loneliness is linked to a higher risk of cardiovascular disease, dementia, stroke, depression, anxiety, and premature death.
Decreased well-being: Loneliness can lead to lower life satisfaction, decreased productivity, and a higher risk of substance abuse.
Reasons for the Epidemic:

Technological advancements: While technology connects us in some ways, it can also contribute to social isolation by replacing face-to-face interactions.
Urbanization and social mobility: Increased urbanization and mobility can disrupt existing social networks and make it harder to build new ones.
Shifting societal values: Individualism and a focus on material success can sometimes overshadow the importance of strong social bonds.
Addressing the Loneliness Epidemic:

Raising awareness: Recognizing loneliness as a public health issue is crucial for prioritizing solutions.
Promoting social connection: Encouraging community activities, fostering intergenerational relationships, and supporting programs that combat social isolation are essential.
Individual action: Prioritizing meaningful social interactions, reaching out to friends and family, and joining social groups can significantly improve well-being.

Addressing Loneliness:

Seeking Connection: It emphasizes the desire to alleviate loneliness by finding companionship, whether through friendship, romantic relationships, or simply feeling a sense of belonging.
Providing Comfort: It suggests offering solace and support to those who might be feeling isolated or disconnected.
Common Associations:

Lonely Hearts: Historically, "lonely hearts" have been associated with sections in newspapers or magazines where people seeking romantic partners or companionship could place personal ads.
Romantic Love: The phrase often carries connotations of romantic love and the desire to find a partner who can fulfill emotional needs and provide companionship.
Broader Interpretation: It can also encompass seeking any kind of meaningful connection, not just romantic, that can help alleviate feelings of loneliness.

'Eyes On Who' was first minted to the Ethereum Blockchain in September of 2021, making it one of the earliest Music NFTs. 

The original collection consists of 13 unique song tokens, and utilizes an advanced version of a technique known as 'Alpha Compositing' to create ultra limited 1/1  'Blue Chip' editions of digital artworks. Each is hand selected from popular ccO & IP Rights Granted collections. The images were composited by hand, using as many as 30 different layers.

This new edition of 'Eyes On Who' takes art from the original collection and combines it into a mesmerizing motion visual, and has been made widely available to the public here on sound.

Additionally, holders of the 13 OG 'Eyes On Who' NFTs were credited on this release, and granted profit splits.

W.T.F." is more than just a track—it's a playful yet sharp commentary on a period in 2015 when everyone seemed to be trying their hand at rapping or singing. Bored and disillusioned with the flood of mainstream music, I wanted to create something that poked fun at the trend while also showcasing my creative skills. The result was "W.T.F.," a song that doesn’t just ride the wave of lazy, formulaic hits, but challenges it.

The beat, crafted by a producer who instantly knew it was meant for me, set the stage. He told me he could hear me killing it, and that’s exactly what I did. The entire song came together in just five minutes during a laid-back studio session. It was one of those spontaneous moments where everything clicked, and I just ran with it.

"W.T.F." isn’t just about the music; it’s about making a statement. It’s a fun, meme-like track that still holds weight, showing that I’m not here to take the easy, mainstream path. I’m here to carve out my own space in the music world, to create art that’s genuine and stands out. This song is just a taste of what’s to come—an introduction to the real artist behind the music.

I hope "W.T.F." grabs your attention and keeps you hungry for more. It’s just the beginning of a journey where I plan to bring you tracks that truly embody what it means to be an artist with something to say. So, turn it up, enjoy the ride, and stay tuned—there’s a lot more coming your way.

// Station 1 // Postcard

Claire, we have to attend the circus together sometime. I was wandering in Krakow, entirely aimless, when two fellow travelers welcomed me on their journey out of town. Come sunset, I’m surrounded by nomads making a caravan camp near the mountains, trying to sing songs in Ukrainian with them. Bonfire parties with guitar music transcend all cultural boundaries. It’s a vast country out here, and the universe continues its expansion.

// Station 2 // Origins + Itinerary

This song comes from wilderness.

Olena and Marko found me aimless and wandering in Krakow, which somehow led, two days later, to an evening spent by the Western Carpathian mountains surrounded by a larger group of their friends. Guitars around a campfire, melodies sung into the night. After leaving them, I wrote the main theme in trying to capture the mood we’d found.

I forgot about the song until a year later, when it seemed a good idea to collect all the “postcard” songs composed during journeys afar. Many of the themes seemed to want to stay simple and untouched, but “Foot of the Carpathians” presented a deeper mystery. I felt it was worth trying to expand the track’s primary statement into a few different but related harmonies, and introduce it to Nir Sabag (drums) and Hugo Reydet (bass) with room for melodic and rhythmic improvisation. I hoped a trio in musical conversation would be fitting for a song born from a small gathering.

We, together with longtime production friends Virgil Segal and Brian Trahan, recorded the track at TRIXX Studios in Berlin, Germany. The soundscapes were meticulously scored later, combining sounds found separately. This could not have been accomplished without Brian’s impeccable sound engineering. Full sound credits are listed at https://travelpoems.com/#about – however, the primary contribution to the vibe of the soundscapes in this track is a recording of a Tibetan singing bowl, made in Duisburg, tuned to the frequency of the asteroid Ceres.

“Foot of the Carpathians” is the 6th stop on _Travel Poems . Chapter 1 . Secret towns_. Travel Poems is a 3-chapter album series unfolding across 30 tracks in total — and will be minted in its entirety on Sound.

“Foot of the Carpathians” accompanies an award-winning music video (CMJ) of the same title, in photo-roman style: https://youtu.be/QIhPhxYTXUg.

If hearing this song evokes for you any memories, or fantasies, or other stories, I would love to know — just message me at pandelic on socials/chat. The live Travel Poems show features immersive storytelling, so it may be possible to weave your story into the musical experience.

// Station 5 // Biography

Imagine a universe where we are connected by shimmering beams of light, everyone to everyone. One quirk about this universe is that the beams send emotions between us, one million per minute per pair, clearly and effortlessly. Joy is instantly contagious. A hurtful thought toward another is understood with compassion, seen alongside the place of sadness where it arose. Every feeling triggers infinite empathy, therefore boundless acceptance. (The beams send only the stuff of our souls, not our thoughts — so we still have privacy, interesting conversation, and the ability to prank each other silly.)

Now imagine we already live in this universe except, long ago, we somehow forgot where the beams disappeared off to. But we’ve always kept music with us, because it’s our best way to speak in the old way.

+

Taiwan-born & reared on-the-go between Taipei and the American Southwest, Eric Pan (a.k.a. pandelic) found his musical footing via a jazz mentorship with Ray Brown at the University of California. These studies propelled him onto stages with Jeff Hamilton and Roy Hargrove, plus over a decade’s tenure as New York City pianist & composer. Pan’s compositions and improvisations reveal a relentless pursuit of simplicity, craft, and universality.

Hear him interviewed on-air next to Orson Welles on national radio with PRI’s “The World”, read his exclusive premiere interview in JAZZIZ Magazine, and stream/download his latest long-form interview on the _For a Living_ podcast.

records.title: Secret Thoughts in a TEENAGE Mind

Description:
TEEN GIRLZ are especially vulnerable to certain mental health struggles. 
Here are some of the top concerns:

Anxiety Disorders:  Research shows a higher prevalence of anxiety disorders in teen girls compared to boys. This can manifest as excessive worry, social anxiety, panic attacks, and physical symptoms like rapid heartbeat and sweating.

Depression:  Unfortunately, depression rates are also on the rise among teen girls.  Symptoms include prolonged sadness, loss of interest in activities, changes in sleep or appetite, feelings of worthlessness, and even suicidal thoughts.

Eating Disorders:  Social pressures around body image and the pursuit of thinness can lead to eating disorders like anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, and binge eating disorder.  These disorders can have serious physical and mental health consequences.

Self-Harm:  Teen girls may engage in self-harm behaviors like cutting, burning, or scratching themselves as a way to cope with difficult emotions.

Social Media and Body Image:  The constant barrage of idealized images on social media can contribute to feelings of inadequacy and low self-esteem, worsening mental health struggles.

Here are some additional factors that can increase the risk of mental health problems in teen girls:

Academic Pressure:  The pressure to succeed academically can be a significant source of stress for girls.

Bullying and Cyberbullying:  Experiencing bullying or cyberbullying can have a devastating impact on a teen's mental health.

Relationship Issues:  Navigating friendships and romantic relationships can be challenging for teens, and difficulties in these areas can contribute to mental health problems.

Family History of Mental Illness:  Having a family history of mental illness can increase a teen's risk.


TEEN BOYZ also face unique challenges that can affect their mental health. 

Here are some of the key issues:

Social Stigma: There can be a strong societal pressure for boys to be stoic and unemotional. This can make it difficult for them to seek help for mental health issues, as they may fear being seen as weak.

Anxiety: Anxiety disorders are prevalent in teen boys as well, though they may manifest differently than in girls. Boys might express anxiety through anger, irritability, or risky behaviors.

Depression: Depression can appear differently in boys too.  They might show symptoms like fatigue, changes in appetite, withdrawal from social activities, or difficulty concentrating.

Substance Abuse:  Boys are more likely than girls to use alcohol and drugs, which can be a way of coping with difficult emotions or social pressure.

Academic Pressure:  Just like girls, boys can feel immense pressure to succeed in school, leading to stress and anxiety.

Bullying and Cyberbullying:  Boys are also targets of bullying and cyberbullying, which can have a negative impact on their mental health.

Body Image:  While not as prevalent as with girls, social media and cultural messages can create unrealistic expectations for boys' bodies, leading to body image issues and low self-esteem.

Lack of Positive Male Role Models:  Teens often benefit from having positive male role models who express a healthy range of emotions.  A lack of such figures can make it harder for boys to understand and express their own feelings.

Similar to girls, there are factors that can increase the risk of mental health problems in teen boys:

Family History of Mental Illness
History of Trauma or Abuse
Learning Disabilities
Remember, mental health issues are treatable. If you are concerned about a teen boy in your life, encourage him to open up and seek help. Here are some resources:

National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI): 1-800-950-NAMI (6264) or https://www.nami.org/Home

Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA): 1-800-662-HELP (4357) or https://www.samhsa.gov/

The Jed Foundation: https://jedfoundation.org/ (focuses on teen mental health)

For "No Others" (和平之歌), Davyd and I have continued to explore even deeper into the fusion of our diverse musical and cultural backgrounds, presenting a track that resonates with themes of unity and peace. This second single from our collaboration continues to blend the essence of my Chinese and British heritage with Davyd's Argentinian roots, creating a sound that transcends traditional genre boundaries.

In "No Others," we've expanded our exploration of cross-cultural influences, drawing inspiration from the concept of 和平 (peace) as a universal aspiration. The lyrics weave together Mandarin and English, echoing the harmonious blend of East and West, while the music incorporates elements of afro beat avant-pop style.

Davyd's production brings an innovative edge to the arrangement, seamlessly integrating contemporary afro beats into our unique Latin-Chinese hybrid that is both uplifting and thought-provoking. My vocal performance aims to embody the spirit of 和平, conveying a message of hope and connection across cultural divides.

This song marks a significant step in our journey together, further cementing our commitment to breaking down barriers through music. The accompanying artwork for "No Others" reflects the song's message of unity, featuring a harmonious blend of visual elements from our respective cultures, symbolising the possibility of peace and understanding in a diverse world.

Together, we hope to inspire others to find common ground in the beauty of our differences, making "No Others" (和平之歌) a heartfelt anthem for unity in times of division.

"Para Hablarte" no solo es una balada de Rock Argentino, sino también un reflejo de la resiliencia y la creatividad desatada durante los tiempos desafiantes de la pandemia. Esta canción se convirtió en el alma del álbum "Bienvenido", un proyecto que amalgama las emociones y experiencias compartidas a lo largo de un período sin precedentes.

La pieza musical se enriquece con la esencia de Tandil y la provincia de Buenos Aires, donde cada nota lleva la impronta de los músicos locales que, con su talento y pasión, han tejido una red de sonidos que captura el espíritu de una comunidad unida por el arte.

El disco "Bienvenido" es más que una colección de canciones; es un viaje sonoro que invita al oyente a explorar los rincones más íntimos de la experiencia humana, desde la soledad y el anhelo hasta la esperanza y la celebración de la vida. Cada pista es una historia, y "Para Hablarte" es la voz que nos guía a través de este paisaje auditivo, recordándonos que incluso en los momentos más oscuros, la música puede ser un faro de luz y unión.

Dissociative identity disorder (DID), formerly known as multiple personality disorder (MPD), is a mental health condition characterized by the presence of two or more distinct identities or personality states that control a person's behavior at different times.

Each identity, also known as an alter, may have its own unique name, voice, mannerisms, memories, and relationships. People with DID experience gaps in their memory, often related to traumatic experiences. They may also lose track of time or find objects in places they don't remember putting them.

DID is a complex disorder that is caused by a combination of genetic and environmental factors. It is thought to be a coping mechanism developed in response to severe trauma, such as abuse or neglect, in early childhood.

Treatment for DID focuses on helping the person integrate their different identities and manage their symptoms. Psychotherapy, such as hypnotherapy and trauma-focused cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), can be helpful. Medication may also be prescribed to treat symptoms such as depression, anxiety, or insomnia.

DID is a rare disorder, but it can be very disabling. If you think you or someone you know may have DID, it is important to seek professional help.

"Shadow" is the fifth single from my debut album Spectres.

Comprising 13 experimental tracks produced over the last seven years, Spectres is the 28th release in my discography but my first ever completely solo full-length album. While working on this record, I delved deep into Jungian psychology, concepts from which became central to the project. All 13 tracks are named after archetypes—innate, universal forces that shape our experience of the world.

Spectres is also a visual art project. For each track, I crowd-sourced images submitted in response to the corresponding archetype. These image collections were used to train bespoke Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), simulating the complex interplay between individual psyche and collective unconscious. A further GAN was trained on selected outputs from all the previous GANs, uniting the various archetypes to form an integrated Self.

By limiting the training time of these AI models, I found I could achieve results that mirrored the formation of archetypal symbols as I imagine them deep in our collective unconscious: elusive yet powerful forms emerging from abstract swirls of colour. From thousands of outputs, I selected and manually edited one per archetype to create unique artworks for each track. A collection of 144 further images from this project will be released digitally under the title Spectral Shadows.

Ultimately, Spectres is more than a collection of WAVs and JPGs; it is a dialogue between the personal and the universal, a multidisciplinary exploration of the forces that connect us all. The album has taken me on a transformative seven-year journey through sound, imagery and psyche. In the process, individual and collective experience harmonise, casting a light into the profound depths of human interconnectedness.

Before its official release on 11/23, I'm rolling Spectres out across the web3 ecosystem, with drops on Sound, Zora, Rodeo, Lens and other emerging platforms. In a novel release structure, collectors of individual tracks gain instant access to stream the full album months before its official release. The goal is to push the limits of onchain interoperability to explore what a web3-native album release can look like in 2024.

The Golden Tuning Technology of 432 Hertz


I’ve been experimenting with 432 Hz since 2019, ever since I came across this information, I became very passionate about the power and the sacred nature of sound. Music and everything in this universe , at its core, is a frequency. Everything is alive, everything is vibrating.

In my personal quest, for self-discovery, sound always played an important role. I began using sound to meditate, making much easier to concentrate and achieve profound meditational states. The use of binaural beats, isochronic tones, solfeggio frequencies and other sacred frequencies proved me over time the its immense power. Sound has deep connections into our emotions, thoughts, and even physiological responses.

Throughout history for thousands of years human beings have been using sound to access deeper states of consciousness, expand awareness and heal the body. Chanting, singing bowls, meditation gongs, and mantras are some ways we've used sound for these benefits.

The Impact on Human Consciousness

Our brain processes information electrically, communicating with cellular structures within specific frequency bands. This understanding forms the basis of how external frequencies can influence our perceptions and states of mind.

Every emotional state generates its own frequency. Hate resonates differently from love, just as conflict-filled environments emit distinct frequencies. These frequencies can alter the electromagnetic fields around us, influencing how we perceive and interact with our surroundings. Even every organ of our body has a specific resonating frequency.

Sound also has the ability to embed messages below the threshold of conscious perception. These messages can directly target the subconscious, shaping beliefs, emotions, and actions. Such subtle influence can lead to collective responses, triggering mass emotions like rage or unrest.

The Power of Frequencies

As a producer, I started experimenting with 432 Hertz tuning in all of my music, noticing significant changes. Music felt more easy to hear, I didn’t get tired as fast working and composing, I could last longer working without ear fatigue. I also noticed the emotion in my songs where not as overwhelming. Compared to 440 Hertz where I found them exaggerated. In traditional tuning sad songs felt even more intense, happy songs felt more euphoric. I would definitely encourage you to experiment this on your own, look for a 432 Hertz version of your favorite song and compare in this particular aspect.

The Golden Tuning Technology of 432 Hertz amplifies the foundational coherence of the body, harmonically aligning our nervous system, health, well-being, and increased creative cognition-inspiration. The potential healing properties of 432 Hz music, citing studies that suggest it can reduce anxiety, improve sleep and immune response, lower blood pressure, and have positive effects on overall well-being.  Research shows that music affects digestion, internal secretion, blood circulation, nutrition, breathing, etc.

It affects the body in two ways:

-With a direct effect, i.e. influence of sound on cells and organs

-Indirectly - through the impact on emotions and our subconscious mind, which in turn influence many processes in the human body.

“There's no organ system in the body that's not affected by sound, music, and vibration. You can look at disease as a form of disharmony.” — Mitchell Gaynor.

This is where the language of the universe, biology, the intelligence of compassionate love, consciousness, genetics, and sacred geometry dance together in synergy. This frequency is obtained in an interesting way: 24 hours x 60 minutes x 60 seconds = 86400/2 = 43200. Historically, many ancient cultures, from the Egyptians to the Greeks, understood and utilized the power of sound. Pythagoras, for instance, spoke of the 'music of the spheres,' which is intrinsically linked to the harmonic principles of 432 Hz.

Encapsulating a true representation of facing ourselves at every stage of our evolution, Tammie’s debut delves into themes of isolation, self-reflection and the egoic state of mind – a relatable exploration of the struggle to find happiness amidst self doubt. Produced by Grammy-nominated and Multi-platinum Billboard-charting producer, The 25th Hour - Andrew Gowie (acclaimed for his work with Lou Val, JON VINYL, Majid Jordan and Drake), ‘Help Me Help Myself’ opens with a soundscapes of modulation drenched guitar under Tammie’s silky vocals. Hi! We're Forenn, and we make music for memory seekers. 🔆

At the beginning of lockdown 2020, one of us lived in Kenya, another in Houston, and another in Austin. We hadn't played music in the same room together since 2016, and it was immediately impressed upon us that we likely wouldn't be doing so again anytime soon. As we collectively spent some time listening to old demos we had made for our first album and sketches we'd written individually over the years since, we realized that a quiet season was ripe for creating new music

As we began writing new music, one thing became clear —we were older, and life was changing for us and the world around us. We started thinking about how those whose lives were passing on due to COVID were forever changing the lives of those they impacted and how memory is the only thing people have left when their loved ones are gone. We began to understand the opportunity we had been given-The opportunity to create a soundtrack of sorts for the memories of the listener's past, their present lives, and the lives to come for those who listen to our music. We realized that art doesn't die-it passes on.

"Peace Is Not Escape" is a song that explores the different emotions and realities of life that we face when confronted with death and the world around us. It acknowledges that life is not always easy, and we are sure to experience a range of emotions from pain and anguish to anger and hurt, as well as joy and celebration. Although peace may not always be an escape from life's challenges, it is still a worthy pursuit. We hope that this song resonates with you, no matter what season of life you are in.

"Sabide" is a sonic journey exploring the intersection of manipulated electronics and organic instrumentation. The track unfolds through distorted electronic textures that form a dynamic foundation, layered with choral samples, string fragments, and piano notes.
The atmosphere is introspective and fragmented, where digital and acoustic sounds intersect to create an almost dreamlike soundscape. Synthesizers emerge as surprising elements, enriching the musical narrative with unexpected tones.
The composition narrates a Saturday in Friuli through a kaleidoscope of sounds: sonic memories that dissolve and regenerate, oscillating between electronic distortions and delicate natural resonances. A brief instrumental voyage that captures the essence of a moment, suspended between reality and imagination, where each sound is a fleeting impression of time and place.
The piece invites listeners into an immersive experience, blurring boundaries between electronic manipulation and acoustic purity, creating a unique auditory landscape that feels both familiar and alien.

After experiencing my first proper performances my junior year of college, I came home with the idea to channel this energy into a song. For me, performing is an exhilarating experience that brings me into the moment like nothing else. I spend all day thinking and practicing for that very moment, but once I’m on stage and my music starts playing, I forget about everything. My body is taken over by my passion for my art. The music somehow takes all my fears and washes them away, leaving only my true self behind.

Much of the verses touch on the topics of fear since this is the main challenge for me when I perform. The authenticity of beating those fears is what drives me to keep pushing. Guided by the beat, I am able to show myself confidently and light-heartedly. Since I was young, I battled with social anxiety in larger group settings. I often didn’t know what to say or how to act in these settings, which made me feel inauthentic. This would cause feedback loops in my head, making every situation more serious than it was. However, if my music is playing, I can be in front of a million people and still be authentic. Hope y’all can feel this energy in the song, and thank you!

'Covet' serves as the first single from the forthcoming Agablis album. Creating a melodic drum and bass piece, this track was recorded with live sampled drums, lush guitar, and intimate and prayerful vocals. It layers dissonant tension with sharp drum breaks against ethereal vocals and inviting synth soundscapes.

Covet takes inspiration from early drum and bass artists like Photek, Grooverider, Roni Size, and Goldie while still blending experimental elements familiar to the Agablis sound.

The lyrics expose a deeply personal and spiritual journey, seeking restoration, grace, and reassurance of God’s love.

The first verse is a prayerful surrender of vulnerability, searching for answers and forgiveness. “You knew me then” is a reflection on a past closeness with God, a time when faith felt stronger and more certain. “Just asking for a friend” hints at a quiet plea for help.

The second verse  shifts toward a renewal of faith and trust in  the gift of God.’s grace, overcoming doubt and relying on God’s unchanging love. “You love me, still” emphasizes the unwavering nature of divine love, even through struggles.

The bridge builds with a sense of growing conviction—“I know… I know… you love me still.” The call to “run to Him and confess” urges surrender and release, with “unclench your fists” symbolizing letting go of burdens or resistance. Leading to a moment of complete freedom, “so free… Jesus with me,” reinforcing the peace found in Jesus.

The words of the song were inspired from the  book of psalms where “How sweet are Your words,” liken God’s word to honey, drawing from Psalm 119:103, which speaks of the sweetness of divine truth. 

Raw and vulnerable, these lyrics cry out for healing, wrestle with doubt, and find freedom in God’s grace. His endless love  brings surrender, peace, and a forgiveness that sets us free.

Enter the introspective world of Mr.FLEN with the latest track, "Promises Like Snow", a poignant exploration of the fragility and fleeting nature of promises. Much like the ephemeral beauty of snow that captivates with its purity but melts away upon touch, this song delves deep into the heart of transient commitments, echoing the all-too-familiar experience of promises made and then dissolved, leaving nothing but a lingering sense of what could have been.

At the core of "Promises Like Snow" lies a message about the beauty and pain of ephemeral moments. Through the metaphor of snow—beautiful, pure, yet fleeting—Mr.FLEN crafts a narrative that resonates on a universal level, touching on the shared human experience of holding onto the words and promises that, despite their initial warmth, fade away when needed the most.

Drawing inspiration from personal anecdotes and the collective experiences of those around him, Mr.FLEN embarked on this musical journey to capture the essence of ephemeral promises. The creative process behind the song was a deeply introspective path, weaving together delicate melodies, thoughtful lyrics, and atmospheric arrangements to mirror the transient nature of snow—captivating but momentary.

The track stands out not only for its lyrical depth but also for its musical composition. Blending elements of indie and alternative pop with a touch of electronic ambiance, "Promises Like Snow" invites listeners into a sonic landscape as vast and pristine as a snow-covered field, illuminated by the first light of dawn. Each chord and beat serves to enhance the narrative, creating an immersive experience that allows the audience to feel the chill of disappearing promises and the warmth of hope that lies in the promise of new beginnings.

Beyond the music, "Promises Like Snow" is a call to reflection. It urges listeners to contemplate the nature of the promises they make and receive. It’s a reminder of the beauty in every moment, even those that are fleeting, and a nudge to cherish the impermanent, for it’s often in transience that we find the deepest meaning and connection.

As you journey through the layers of "Promises Like Snow", Mr.FLEN invites you to share your own stories of ephemeral promises. Engage with the song, not just as listeners, but as fellow storytellers, contributing your own experiences of beauty, loss, and the fleeting moments that, like snowflakes, leave a lasting impression on the soul.

Join Mr.FLEN on this emotional expedition, and let "Promises Like Snow" be a soundtrack to your own reflections on the transient, yet beautiful nature of life's many promises.

Neurodivergence refers to individuals whose brains function in ways that are different from what's considered typical. It's an umbrella term encompassing a variety of conditions, including:

Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)
Autism spectrum disorder (ASD)
Dyslexia
Dyspraxia
People with neurodivergence may experience the world differently in terms of:

Information processing
Learning styles
Sensory processing
Communication styles
Social interaction

The concept of neurodiversity emphasizes that these variations are not inherently negative.  Many neurodivergent people have unique strengths and talents. 

For instance, people with ADHD may be highly creative and energetic, and autistic individuals may excel at focus and pattern recognition.

It's important to note that neurodivergence can also present challenges.  Some people may struggle with social interaction, organization, or communication.  

The key takeaway is that neurodiversity is a spectrum, and every individual's experience is unique.

records.title: Rapper Abunai ’s munchin’ on a Cosmic Brownie

Description:
Well, lemme tell ya 'bout the strangest thing I ever saw workin’ at Cumberland Farms. I’m behind the counter, just doin' my shift like any ol' day, when in walks this fella. Rapper Abunai got this wild look in his eye, like he’s seen a ghost or maybe just had one too many sips from the wrong end of a jug.

Rapper Abunai got this wild look in his eye, like he’s seen a ghost or maybe just had one too many sips from the wrong end of a jug.

,Rapper Abunai ’s munchin’ on a Cosmic Brownie, right there, wrapper an' all. I’m thinkin’ to myself, "Well, that’s a new one." But I don’t say a word, just keep on with my restocking.

Next thing I know, he plops himself down right on the counter. I’m not talkin’ 'bout sittin' on a stool or leanin' against it. I’m talkin’ ‘bout right on top of the counter. And then, wouldn’t you know it, he starts to take a shit. Right there. On the counter. No shame, no hesitation. Just droppin’ his load like it’s the most natural thing in the world.

Now, you’d think that would be the end of it, but nah, he finishes up, wipes his hands clean, and then proceeds to reach into his pocket. Pulls out a crumpled bill and says, "I’d like to pay for this Cosmic Brownie, please."

He’s holdin’ up the brownie, still wrapped in its dirty glory, like it’s a trophy or somethin'.

I’m standin' there, flabbergasted, tryin’ to wrap my head around this whole ordeal. I gotta make a call, you see, but part of me’s still wonderin’ if I’d somehow slipped into a fever dream. The audacity of it all—the nerve!

So, I tell him, "You can keep your brownie, buddy. Just... get the hell outta here." And he does, like it’s just another day for him. And there I am, scramblin' to clean up the mess, tryin' to make sense of the cosmic lunacy that just unfolded.


Well...he was Rapper Abunai.

And that’s the tale of the Cosmic Brownie incident. They don’t teach you that in any customer service manual, I’ll tell ya that much.

The penultimate single from Spectres deals with the archetype of the Hero, whose main feat, according to Jung, is "to overcome the monster of darkness: it is the long-hoped-for and expected triumph of consciousness over the unconscious." Jung also wrote that "mythologically, the hero’s goal is to find the treasure, the princess, the ring, the golden egg, elixir of life, etc. Psychologically these are metaphors for one’s true feelings and unique potential."

Comprising 13 experimental tracks produced over the last seven years, Spectres is the 28th release in my discography but my first ever completely solo full-length album. While working on this record, I delved deep into Jungian psychology, concepts from which became central to the project. All 13 tracks are named after archetypes—innate, universal forces that shape our experience of the world.

Spectres is also a visual art project. For each track, I crowd-sourced images associated with the corresponding archetype. These image collections were used to train bespoke Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), simulating the complex interplay between individual psyche and collective unconscious. A further GAN was trained on selected outputs from all the previous GANs, uniting the various archetypes to form an integrated Self.

By limiting the training time of these AI models, I found I could achieve results that mirrored the formation of archetypal symbols as I imagine them deep in our collective unconscious: elusive yet powerful forms emerging from abstract swirls of colour. From thousands of outputs, I selected and manually edited one per archetype to create unique artworks for each track. A collection of 144 further images from this project dropped under the title Spectral Shadows.

Ultimately, Spectres is more than a collection of WAVs and JPGs; it is a dialogue between the personal and the universal, a multidisciplinary exploration of the forces that connect us all. The album has taken me on a transformative seven-year journey through sound, imagery and psyche. In the process, individual and collective experience harmonise, casting a light into the profound depths of human interconnectedness.

Before its official release on 11/23, I'm rolling Spectres out across the web3 ecosystem, with drops on Sound, Zora, Rodeo, Lens and other emerging platforms. In a novel release structure, collectors of individual tracks gain instant access to stream the full album months before its official release. The goal is to push the limits of onchain interoperability to explore what a web3-native album release can look like in 2024.

"Living for a While" is a reflective song about embracing the present moment and finding meaning in fleeting experiences. Its lyrics explore themes of impermanence, self-discovery, and the beauty of living in the now, accompanied by soothing melodies that evoke a sense of calm and introspection. The song invites listeners to pause, reflect, and appreciate the small, often overlooked moments that define our lives.

Struggle against darkness and despair: The song opens with lines like “feeling lost in endless gray” and “heavy heart, weary mind,” setting a somber tone and depicting the overwhelming nature of depression. This struggle is further emphasized by the imagery of shadows, silence, and rain.

Resilience and hope: Despite the darkness, the song also conveys a message of resilience and hope. Lines like “hold on tight,” “glimmer of hope,” and “dancing through the darkness” suggest that even in the depths of depression, there is a spark of strength and a yearning for something better.

Breaking free from pain: The song encourages listeners to break free from the shackles of depression and pain. Lines like “chasing stars in the sky,” “breaking the silence,” and “rising above the pain” symbolize the fight against negativity and the desire to find joy again.

Finding strength and courage: The lyrics emphasize the inner strength and courage needed to overcome depression. Lines like “fire burns wiping away the stress” and “courage in your soul” highlight the potential for healing and self-empowerment.

Universal experience: The song resonates with many listeners because it speaks to a universal human experience – the struggle with mental health. By sharing his own story, Harshmxjb creates a sense of connection and understanding for those who have also faced depression.

This track isn’t just catchy; it's culturally insightful, reflecting the new norms and challenges of identity in the age of digital art and non-fungible tokens (NFTs). Choosing a PFP is more than picking a picture—it's about finding a visual identity that stands out in the vast sea of digital personas.

So, whether you're deep into the NFT scene or just love the concept of virtual representation, "My PFP" from The Crew is your soundtrack. Turn it up and let The Crew guide you through the digital gallery of potential selves, reminding us all how revolutionary and bewildering the world of NFTs can be.

Step into the sonic world of self-reflection with "Cope," the fifth single from The Crew’s groundbreaking album that continues to merge the worlds of crypto-culture and arena rock. The track, steeped in the virtual band’s signature blend of 80s glam rock bravado and modern digital discourse, addresses a universal theme in the volatile world of cryptocurrency investments—missing out.

Here’s a peek at the reflective and resonant lyrics of "Cope":

Checking the chart is breaking my heart,
Dreaming of gains I missed from the start.

"Cope" delves into the emotional rollercoaster that many face when they miss out on what could have been a life-changing investment. It's a poignant reminder of the highs and lows that come with the territory of speculative markets. However, The Crew doesn't leave the listener in despair; instead, they offer a lifeline of perspective and a reminder of life’s broader canvas.

The song transitions from the pain of missed opportunities to a powerful affirmation of life beyond the market's chaos. It reflects a mature, philosophical take on the concept of "fear of missing out" and turns it into a celebration of what is truly valuable—love, laughter, and personal contentment. The chorus isn’t just a lament; it's an anthem for finding strength and joy outside the ephemeral thrills of financial success.

"Cope" is more than just a song; it's a musical coping mechanism for anyone who's felt the sting of missed chances, not just in crypto, but in any aspect of life. The Crew, once again, proves they’re not just about beats and rhymes; they're about echoing the heartbeat of a community, reminding us all that sometimes, the best gains aren’t measured in currency, but in experiences and emotional growth. Turn up "Cope" when the charts are down, and remember: in life’s grand scheme, you're already rich.

I'm sharing this song today as a sincere thank you to every single one of my collectors and listeners. 

I just hit a big sobriety milestone, and these last six months of living alcohol-free have offered me some of the most profound moments of transformation, healing, and artistic growth I've ever experienced in my lifetime. 

If you've ever collected one of my songs onchain, come to a show, or supported me in any capacity big or small, you've afforded me the opportunity to take a step back since my last album release and reevaluate my life. 

Collector support from the web3 community, as well as support from my family has given me the resources and a safe environment to finally seek the professional help I've needed for a long time. I've been able to (re)start the journey of recovery, and I'm forever grateful for this care. 

One of the most unexpected but exciting byproducts of doing this work is how therapy has been changing the sound of the music I create -- I'm finally feeling more confident and open to share my voice, and create more lyric-driven songs that put words to my feelings. 

I used to find a lot of comfort in the ambiguity of instrumental music, as well as layering / editing my voice so far past the point of recognition that even I couldn't tell it was me singing anymore. It was easier to leave things open to wide interpretation than clearly speak what I feel. So I'm doing my best to shift that and continue growing as an artist. 

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for listening, and giving me space to share this music. Collecting my songs has a direct impact on my life beyond music, and I'll never stop saying thank you for all of these opportunities.

records.title: Mizter Bonezz feat. Xzibit - F* Organized Religion

Description:
"F* Organized Religion" is a groundbreaking track that fuses the high-energy world of psytrance with the provocative and incisive lyricism of hip-hop, featuring the iconic rapper Xzibit. This collaboration between Mizter Bonezz and Xzibit creates a unique musical journey that challenges societal norms and critiques the establishment, particularly organized religion. The track stands out not only for its innovative blend of genres but also for its bold, thought-provoking message.

**Musical Style:**
The musical backbone of "F* Organized Religion" is rooted in psytrance, known for its fast tempos, repetitive hypnotic beats, and complex layered soundscapes. The track features a relentless, driving bassline that propels the energy forward, accompanied by intricate, evolving rhythms and atmospheric synthesizers. These elements create an immersive and dynamic auditory experience, characteristic of the best psytrance music.

The production incorporates classic psytrance elements such as acid lines, cosmic sound effects, and intense build-ups that lead to euphoric drops. The beat structure is designed to keep the listener engaged, providing a continuous sense of motion and evolution. This pulsating foundation is perfectly complemented by Xzibit’s gritty and powerful vocal performance, which adds an extra layer of intensity to the track.

**Lyrics and Themes:**
Xzibit’s contribution to "F* Organized Religion" is both fearless and incisive. His lyrics provide a scathing critique of organized religion, focusing on the perceived hypocrisy, exploitation, and manipulation within religious institutions. The verses delve into themes of financial greed, the use of fear and guilt to control followers, and the historical conflicts fueled by religious divisions.

Xzibit questions the motives behind religious leaders' actions, challenging the integrity and authenticity of their teachings. His delivery is raw and impassioned, matching the aggressive and relentless nature of the psytrance beat. The juxtaposition of Xzibit’s hard-hitting lyrics with the hypnotic and intense musical backdrop creates a compelling and thought-provoking experience for the listener.

**Impact and Reception:**
"F* Organized Religion" has made a significant impact due to its bold subject matter and innovative fusion of genres. Fans of psytrance appreciate the high-energy production and intricate sound design, while hip-hop enthusiasts are drawn to Xzibit’s powerful and thought-provoking lyrics. The track has sparked widespread discussion and debate, with reactions ranging from high praise for its courage and creativity to criticism for its provocative stance.

The collaboration showcases the versatility and willingness of both Mizter Bonezz and Xzibit to push boundaries and explore new musical territories. This track not only highlights the artists' individual talents but also demonstrates the potential for cross-genre collaborations to create something truly unique and impactful.

**Conclusion:**
"F* Organized Religion" by Mizter Bonezz featuring Xzibit is a standout track that challenges listeners to question and reflect on the role of organized religion in society. The fusion of psytrance’s hypnotic, high-energy beats with Xzibit’s incisive and provocative lyricism creates a powerful and unforgettable musical experience. This track is a testament to the artists' commitment to pushing creative boundaries and addressing complex, often controversial themes through their music.

Drawing inspiration from Chinese poetry and the fiery energy of transformation, “Fuego”, the latest single from Endless Summer (无尽夏日), our upcoming album by Davyd and myself, reflects on impermanence and renewal.

Chinese New Year is a time of spring and fresh beginnings, and 2025 is the Year of the Green Snake, known in China as the “Little Dragon.” This symbolism runs deep in the song, with lyrics like "一点一点出淤泥, 一个一个化为灰烬" ("Little by little, rising from the mud; one by one, turning to ashes"). These words evoke the cyclical dance of creation and destruction, inspired by Buddhist traditions.

The recurring line, “Through a thousand ego eyes,” reflects on the many faces and lenses through which the ego perceives the world, shaping how we experience life. By recognising the illusions and stories created by our egos, we can step closer to our true selves - ending cycles of suffering and embracing a deeper sense of peace and renewal.

Blending my Chinese-British musical roots with Davyd’s South American heritage, “Fuego” is a track that invites you to welcome the spirit of change. As we step into the Year of the Snake, take this opportunity to reflect, reconnect, and transform. Let Fuego ignite your journey toward your true self and help you burn away what no longer serves you.

Velvet Meadow brings a new psychedelic pop single "Ive Come To Realize" which is track 3 off his upcoming new psych pop/rock album coming 2024 "Never Want To Leave My Head". During the year of 2023 Kris Heironimus was struggling for inspiration for his new album. He spent two months just listening to his favorite artists, and experimenting with self taught production tricks. After blasting the Beatles Magical Mystery Tour,  MGMTs Congratulations, PONDS The Weather, and many other amazing psych artists he took a new direction with his music Focusing heavily on sonic textures as well as pop lyrics and melodies. "Ive Come To Realize" pushes the boundaries of mainstream pop norms as well as progressing the indie soundscape deeper into the unknown. Sit back and sink into the couch because this one will be a ride! 

Press:

Synth shimmers and a deeply grooving bass line traverse into a hazy vocal, singing “she’s got me in her heart-shaped box,” with a soaring intrigue. The vocals ascend alongside buzzing synth insertions just prior to the one-minute mark, taking this already-riveting psychedelic soundscape to the next level. “Let me show you, sweetheart, just give me one try,” the vocals plead further, emitting a sense of yearning amidst the steady production and title-touting punctuation. “Ive Come To Realize” is a stellar psych-forward success from Velvet Meadow. - Mike Mineo // Obscure Sound

This Mixtape Edition is a raw intimate glimpse at the emotional journey that shaped "seeing red feeling blue". 

The success of my Love Letters Music NFT collection was a game-changer, propelling me from the uncertainty of independent artistry to the unimaginable — touring with Snow Patrol and Robbie Williams. In a music world dominated by major labels, web3 gave me a chance to break through barriers, but it also brought a whirlwind of highs and lows. This EP was born from that rollercoaster, capturing both the euphoric thrill of success and the crushing lows of hitting rock bottom, wrestling with doubt and uncertainty.

Each track on this mixtape tells a part of that story—from the resilience in “Fight Another Day” to the introspection of “Sleep On It.” This digital mixtape is a rare, limited-edition piece, created for those who’ve been an integral part of this journey and want to hold onto a piece of its legacy.

First access is reserved for my Love Letters and Stamps Music NFT holders.

The song "Lover Lie Away" by KarimReslan explores themes of deception, attraction, and the desire for honesty in a romantic relationship.

The repeated phrase "Lover lie away" suggests that the person singing or the protagonist of the song is asking their lover to refrain from lying. This could be a plea for transparency and sincerity in the relationship.

The lyrics express a desire for the lover to stay and not hide, indicating a longing for their presence and emotional connection. It portrays a yearning for a genuine and open connection with the partner.

The mention of the lover being like jewelry at a party and dancing suggests a sense of physical attraction and allure. However, the protagonist feels deceived by this initial attraction, as indicated by the line "She wanted what I be experiencing daily." This may imply that the lover was more interested in the persona or lifestyle of the protagonist rather than a genuine connection.

The lyrics also mention the protagonist's hesitation to engage with the lover, describing the encounter as somewhat tedious and uninteresting. This could be an acknowledgment of the lack of depth or emotional fulfillment in the relationship.

Towards the end of the song, there is a reference to the lover disclosing that she is a dancer. The subsequent lines indicate a dissatisfaction with this revelation and a desire to end things, suggesting a realization that their connection was not founded on genuine emotional compatibility. This part of the lyrics may allude to the idea that the relationship was transactional or based on superficial qualities, leading to a feeling of dissatisfaction and the decision to break things off.

Overall, "Lover Lie Away" expresses a longing for honesty, authenticity, and emotional connection in a romantic relationship while highlighting the consequences of superficial attraction and a lack of genuine compatibility.

“#E788A0” by WarBaby of Outside The Wire Productions is a true testament to raw human expression—a one-of-a-kind digital asset that can never be replicated by AI or machines. 

This NFT captures the organic, hand-crafted artistry that emerged from the depths of personal experience. Each sound and layer was crafted “from scratch,” reflecting the intense emotions born from WarBaby’s time in the U.S. Army, especially during high-stakes moments in the Middle East. Music became a mental escape from the chaos around him, transforming adrenaline and inner conflict into powerful soundscapes. 

The audio was professionally and delicately designed, using specific frequencies chosen to heal through sound, frequency, and vibration. This timeless piece of artwork is not only unique; it stands as a tribute to the resilience and authenticity that only human touch can create.

Mizter Bonezz - Lifetime Trip: A Journey Through Sound and Experience

Overview:
“Lifetime Trip” is a captivating track by Mizter Bonezz, a producer known for his intricate and emotional compositions. This song captures the essence of a profound journey, weaving together elements of psytrance, dubstep, and electronic music to create an immersive auditory experience.

Musical Composition:
The track is a masterful blend of pulsating basslines, hypnotic rhythms, and ethereal melodies. It opens with a serene yet mysterious intro, gradually building into a powerful, driving beat that propels listeners into a state of euphoria. The tempo transitions are a defining feature, starting at 160 BPM, escalating to a peak of 200 BPM, and then settling back to 150 BPM. These shifts in tempo create a dynamic and engaging listening experience, reflecting the unpredictable nature of life’s journey. The inclusion of dubstep elements adds a gritty, energetic layer, with wobbly basslines and syncopated rhythms that enhance the track’s intensity.

Emotional Journey:
“Lifetime Trip” is more than just a song; it’s an emotional voyage. The track’s progression mirrors the ups and downs of a lifetime, taking listeners through moments of introspection, exhilaration, and transcendence. The dynamic shifts in tempo and intensity, combined with the heavy drops and melodic interludes typical of dubstep, enhance the emotional depth, making the experience deeply personal and relatable.

Production Quality:
Mizter Bonezz showcases his exceptional production skills in “Lifetime Trip.” Every element is meticulously crafted, with a clear focus on creating a pristine soundscape. The use of spatial effects and stereo imaging enhances the immersive quality of the track, making it a standout piece in his discography. The precise control over the varying BPMs and the seamless integration of psytrance and dubstep elements demonstrate his technical prowess and creativity.

Impact on Listeners:
Fans of Mizter Bonezz have praised “Lifetime Trip” for its ability to transport them to another realm. The track has become a favorite in live performances and DJ sets, resonating with audiences for its emotional depth and high-energy delivery. The fluctuating BPMs and the infusion of dubstep elements keep listeners engaged and excited, ensuring that every moment is captivating.

Who is Mizter Bonezz?

Background:
Mizter Bonezz, born Daniel Amaya on August 13, 1992, is a dynamic and resilient DJ and music producer hailing from Sylmar, California. Known for his versatility and emotional depth in music, Mizter Bonezz has carved out a unique niche in the electronic music scene, blending psytrance, dubstep, and other electronic subgenres to create immersive auditory experiences.

Early Life and Challenges:
Mizter Bonezz’s journey is marked by overcoming significant challenges. He has endured over 300 fractures and undergone more than 18 surgeries due to Osteogenesis Imperfecta, a condition that has shaped much of his life and music. In 2015, he experienced two hypoxic respiratory failures, leading to a life-changing tracheostomy surgery. This surgery left him unable to speak for almost a year and dependent on a feeding tube. Despite these hardships, he has channeled his experiences into his music, creating tracks that resonate deeply with listeners.

Career Beginnings and Breakthroughs:
Mizter Bonezz began his DJ career in 2009 under the alias DJ Gooddan21. His passion for music and innate talent quickly set him apart. He graduated high school in 2011 from Canoga Park Senior High School with a 3.9 GPA and initially pursued an accounting major in college. However, due to deteriorating mental health from untreated bipolar 2 depression, he dropped out in 2013 to fully dedicate himself to music.

In 2019, Mizter Bonezz was discovered by Mandragora after a video of him performing “Codeine” at EDC Las Vegas went viral. This breakthrough led to a signing with Brazil’s Alien Records and a collaboration with Thales Dumbra and Cruzmon VI. He has since become a prominent figure in the psytrance scene, influenced by artists like WADE, Hugel, Mandragora, Vini Vici, and Chapeleiro.

Notable Achievements:

	•	Met and opened for major artists like Skrillex, Steve Aoki, and Wiz Khalifa.
	•	Performed at significant events like DreamState So Cal and supported acts like Coming Soon!!!
	•	Released a 4-song psytrance EP titled “Ayahuasca Village” in May 2024, featuring tracks like “Torment,” “Amnesia,” “Lone Wolf,” and “The Comeback.”
	•	Launched a monthly radio mix show called “Mizter Bonezz Bone Breakin Beatz” on Insomniac Radio, airing every first Tuesday of the month.

Musical Style and Influence:
Mizter Bonezz’s music is characterized by its emotional depth, complex rhythms, and seamless integration of various electronic subgenres. His tracks often feature pulsating basslines, hypnotic rhythms, and ethereal melodies, creating a rich tapestry of sound. His unique style has earned him a dedicated fan base and recognition within the electronic music community.

Personal Life:
Mizter Bonezz’s resilience extends beyond his music career. His mother, affectionately known as “Mama Bonezz,” was diagnosed with stage 4 pancreatic cancer in January 2024 and is undergoing weekly chemotherapy treatments. Despite these personal challenges, Mizter Bonezz continues to inspire others through his music and advocacy.

Impact and Legacy:
Mizter Bonezz’s story is one of perseverance, creativity, and passion. He has not only made a significant impact in the electronic music scene but also serves as an inspiration for those facing their own challenges. His music invites listeners on a journey, reflecting the highs and lows of life and the power of resilience.

With a growing discography and an unwavering commitment to his craft, Mizter Bonezz is poised to continue making waves in the music industry, leaving an indelible mark on those who experience his sound.

"HighBIScus" is a deeply evocative song that weaves together themes of love, life, death, and the intricate relationship between humanity and nature, particularly within an agricultural context. The lyrics paint a vivid picture of a culture embroiled in conflict, where the planting and growing of cannabis become metaphors for resilience, survival, and the cyclical nature of existence.

The opening lines, "You were Mine before the showers, Watered you and gave you power," set the stage for a narrative of nurturing and growth. The metaphorical connection between the protagonist's love and the cultivation of cannabis suggests a symbiotic relationship between human emotions and the natural world. As the song progresses, the lyrics delve into the complexities of life's struggles, juxtaposed with the fragility of existence. The repeated imagery of "Hibiscus flowers" symbolizes both beauty and transience, echoing the fleeting nature of life itself.

Amidst themes of love and growth, the song takes a poignant turn as it addresses the devastating impact of war and loss. Lines like "War torn in a system of culture tradition, They died opposition never changing positions," convey the brutality and futility of conflict, where individuals are caught in cycles of violence and suffering. However, even in the face of tragedy, there's a sense of resilience and reverence for those who have passed, as depicted in the lines, "I place my burden by their halos, Tombstone of their graves, oh lord." Ultimately, "HighBIScus" transcends its reggae roots to become a powerful meditation on the human condition, reminding listeners of the interconnectedness of life, death, and the natural world.

"Swara Sukma Ing Antara" is an electro-horror composition that portrays the inner journey of a soul lost among the shadows of the past. This idea was born in the stillness of midnight, imagining a spirit trapped in shattered memories, filled with regret and despair. To evoke this atmosphere, the piece opens with a repetitive synthesizer sound layered with modulated analog synth distortion, forming a harmony that trembles like fragmented memories. Fragmented melodies from a granular synthesizer emerge like whispers and sobs from the past, as if something unseen is lurking behind the silence.

In the middle of the composition, a hauntingly repetitive pattern from a music box sample and soul-crushing chords appears, depicting the soul’s confrontation with its own unrecognizable shadow. The music reaches its climax through layered, competing dissonances, then collapses into an echoing void and distant screams — a symbol of the soul’s fall into eternal emptiness. Although electronic in nature, this work carries the weight of human emotion, blending horror elements and ambient textures to create a psychological space that invites listeners to confront their own unresolved fears and memories.

BUZZ is one of the most impressive vocalists we’ve heard in the last decade. 

She’s a songwriter with credits on mainstream tracks by Katy Perry, Kylie Minogue, and Bebe Rexha but her own music is closer to pure art.

We first heard her track Liberation — a heart-stopping, stripped-back vocal with only a vocoder synth for texture. It was raw and powerful, signalling the entrance of someone stepping out of the songwriter role in the background and owning the stage as her own. Across the rest of her catalog, BUZZ’s voice effortlessly shifts from pop hooks to almost operatic highs with complete control.

We were lucky enough to work together to bring Liberation onchain and create 12 different remixes from the community. We followed up with Different Sun, and now we’re back with an extremely limited edition of her new single.

There will only be 50 editions of “Left Behind” — another vulnerable and honest track about moving on from her upbringing, letting go of fear and being free in as many ways as possible.

For me, it’s the perfect song to launch our new series of limited editions, where we treat outstanding music moments as works of art. This feels like a turning point for a new artist breaking out and owning her own story.

Hope you like it as much as we do.
